chat.author: Juan Fraire
chat.text: @all we are going for a break and start the next session at 11:10

chat.author: Felix Flentge
chat.text: Isn't this IETF WG group already addressing time-variant routing --> https://datatracker.ietf.org/wg/tvr/about/

chat.author: Juan Fraire
chat.text: TVR has defined a comprehensive data structure to capture the time-evolving topology dynamics, but afaik they have not defined routing logic or method specific for such networks

chat.author: Juan Fraire
chat.text: We will leave Meetecho and be back at 2:30 pm after the ESOC tour
